messages:
elaine: Heads-up: draft relnotes for the SeatMap routing rollout are ready for review. Key points: multi-model routing support, new 'routing_policy' flag with options (latency_pref, cost_pref, balanced), and an opt-in rollout for existing orgs. I've added a Known issues section — most pressing are intermittent 504s during cold starts and an embeddings ordering change that can affect recommendation scoring. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482

mike: on it. do we want a python + ts snippet showing the flag + fallback behaviour?

elaine: yep — minimal samples suffice. quick draft in the PR shows: 
```
# python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.generate('recommendations for user', routing_policy='latency_pref')
```
and a TS sample too. keep it tiny and focused on the param and fallback to single-model route.

sam: localization ping 1. some links in the migration guide still point at old /i18n anchors. i'll run a targeted link sweep once samples are final.

tara: re Known issues: the embed ordering quirk is causing off-by-one score shifts in a couple of customer tests. can we add a recommended workaround: "sort inputs by created_at before batching" and note potential score diffs?

elaine: agree. adding the workaround and linking tracking issue #233. added a short migration snippet for teams that relied on preserved embedding order.

deploy-bot: preview published for PR 482: https://preview.redwood.dev/482 (expires in 48h) :rocket: build: 2026-03-23T14:12Z

anya: tiny wording suggestion: change "opt-in rollout for existing orgs" to "default: off for orgs created before 2026-04-01" 1 clearer for support.

elaine: updated wording and added FAQ note for partner integrations and webhook consumers. moving the PR into docs-queue for copyedit.

docs-lead: action items: mike -> add python + ts snippets; sam -> migration link fixes; tara -> confirm Known issues text; anya -> quick copy pass. please ack with ETA.

mike: ack, i'll push both snippets (python + ts) by EOD today.

sam: ack, i'll grep and replace broken i18n anchors and open a follow-up PR by tomorrow morning.

tara: ack, i'll review the Known issues wording and add a small repro for the embed-order behavior. ETA: tomorrow afternoon.

elaine: thanks all 1 once snippets + link fixes land i'll merge and send the release blurb to marketing. :thumbsup:
